title: WIP CSV export gains the Locations line while its column semantics stay exactly as shipped
preconds:
Owner/admin with WIP access (reports project storage state)
The org has at least two accessible workplaces
One approved WO with clocked time on a unique-VIN vehicle exists in the default (This Week) range, so it lands in the default "Approved - partially completed" tab (seeded via API)
The browser context carries NO saved WIP view, so Location starts default-hidden
